title: Strafed on Christmas Day; firing a 50-caliber gun
summary: During dinner German planes strafe them and he helps man a 50-caliber at a German fighter.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: And during that Christmas Day by the way, a rather interesting thing happened. I knew how to work a 50-caliber machine gun and while we were having dinner we started to get strafed. These 109s started to strafe us and everybody hit the floor you know. And I ran outside and I was down on the ground but I saw this truck with a 50 caliber on it under the hood, not the hood, the cab, top of the cab. We used to have 50 calibers mounted up there.

And these M 109s were coming in and making passes at us. And I asked the guy next to me you know, how a 50? He said, yes. I said, come on, good. I'll feed and you work it or the other way around. We got up in this thing, loaded it up and cocked it and started firing. These M 109s were coming in, about three of them I think it was. And sure enough, of course other guys were firing too. We weren't the only ones firing. But he had it lined up just right.

He was leading it just perfectly and I could see those tracers going in there and we hit it. And he took a big zoom upwards, up through the sky and parachuted and everybody was shooting at him. But I know we helped knock the thing down.
